newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Prop offers more flats at higher price.
newsitem.headline: SHK Prop offers more flats at higher price.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd said it would put another 1,000 units on offer at its East Point City development in Tseung Kwan O for sale on Saturday, bringing the total number of flats offered to 1,608.

A company spokeswoman said the additional units would be offered at an average price of HK$5,214 per square foot, up another three percent from the third batch's HK$5,061 a square foot. The units range from 588 to 796 square feet,
Sun Hung Kai Properties initially offers 304 units at HK$4,771 a square foot, later adding two batches of 152 each.
The spokewoman said a total 27,132 potential buyers have registered to buy the flats at close of a three-day registration period on Wednesday.
